Now the main query.

Publisher "Dark Horse Comics" has 19 heroes. Filter gender = 'Female'.

Query:

SELECT s.superhero_name, ec.colour AS eye_colour, hc.colour AS hair_colour, sc.colour AS skin_colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id
LEFT JOIN colour ec ON s.eye_colour_id = ec.id
LEFT JOIN colour hc ON s.hair_colour_id = hc.id
LEFT JOIN colour sc ON s.skin_colour_id = sc.id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Dark Horse Comics' AND g.gender = 'Female';
